metadata.case_title: Saraya Industries Ltd. vs State Of U.P. And Ors.
metadata.summary: The case involves a dispute regarding the imposition of excise duty on wasted security holograms by distilleries in Uttar Pradesh. Saraya Industries Ltd., a liquor manufacturer, challenged the State Government's policy decision and circulars requiring hologram affixation. The petitioner argued that excise duty cannot be levied on holograms and no evasion was committed. The State contended that the duty was justified to prevent evasion and safeguard public health. The court considered the legal provisions and arguments to determine the validity of imposing excise duty on unaccounted holograms. The case highlighted the importance of regulatory measures and contractual obligations in the liquor manufacturing industry.
